literal: PETER apostle of-Jesus Christ, to-[the]-elect sojourners of-[the]-dispersion of-Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
prose: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect sojourners of the dispersion of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

literal: according to foreknowledge of-God of-Father, in sanctification of-the-Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of-blood of-Jesus Christ. Grace to-you and peace may-be-multiplied.
prose: According to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience and sprinkling with the blood of Jesus Christ. Grace and peace be multiplied to you.

literal: Blessed [be] the God and Father of-the Lord of-us of-Jesus Christ, the-one according-to the great his mercy having-begotten-again us into hope living, through resurrection of-Jesus Christ's from dead-ones,
prose: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy has caused us to be born again to a living hope, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

literal: into an inheritance imperishable and undefiled and unfading,
prose: To an inheritance imperishable, undefiled, and unfading,

literal: having-been-kept in heavens for you, the-ones in power of-God being-guarded through faith, for a-salvation ready to-be-revealed in [the] last time.
prose: Kept in heaven for you, who are being guarded by God's power through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

literal: In which you-rejoice, a-little now, if it-is-necessary, having-been-grieved in various trials,
prose: In this you rejoice, even though for a little while now, if it must be, you have been grieved by various trials,

literal: so-that the tested-genuineness of-you of-the faith, more-precious than-gold, of-the [gold] perishing but through fire being-tested, may-be-found unto praise and glory and honor in revelation of-Jesus Christ.
prose: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

literal: Whom, not having-seen, you-love; into whom now not seeing [him], believing [in him] but you-exult with-joy inexpressible and glorified,
prose: Him, though you have not seen, you love; in him, though you do not now see him, believing, you rejoice with a joy inexpressible and glorified,

literal: Obtaining the end of the faith, salvation of souls.
prose: As you obtain the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

literal: Concerning which salvation sought-out and searched-diligently [the] prophets, the ones concerning the to-you grace prophesying,
prose: Concerning this salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently — those who prophesied about the grace meant for you,

literal: searching-into unto what or what-kind-of time was-indicating the in them Spirit of-Christ, foretelling the unto Christ sufferings and the after these-things glories;
prose: investigating what person or time the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating, when it foretold the sufferings destined for Christ and the glories that would follow them;

literal: To whom it was revealed that not to themselves but to you they were ministering these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached good news to you by Holy Spirit having been sent from heaven, into which things angels desire to look.
prose: It was revealed to them that they were ministering these things not for themselves but for you, things which have now been announced to you through those who preached the good news to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven — things into which angels long to look.

literal: Therefore, having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober completely, hope ye upon the grace being brought to you in revelation of Jesus Christ.
prose: Therefore, having girded up the loins of your mind, being completely sober, set your hope on the grace being brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

literal: As children of obedience, not fashioning-yourselves to-the former, in the ignorance of-you, desires,
prose: As children of obedience, not conforming yourselves to the desires you formerly had in your ignorance,

literal: But according to the [one] who called you [being] holy, you also yourselves holy in all conduct become,
prose: But, just as the one who called you is holy, you also must become holy in all your conduct,

literal: Because it-has-been-written, [that] 'Holy you-shall-be, because I [am] holy.'
prose: For it is written, 'You shall be holy, because I am holy.'

literal: And if as-father you-call-upon the one impartially judging according-to the of-each-person work, in fear the of-the sojourning of-you time conduct-yourselves;
prose: And if you call upon as Father the one who judges impartially according to each person's work, conduct yourselves in fear during the time of your sojourning here.

literal: Knowing that not with-perishable-things, with-silver or with-gold, you-were-redeemed out-of the futile of-you way-of-life handed-down-from-fathers,
prose: Knowing that you were redeemed not with perishable things, silver or gold, from your futile way of life handed down from your fathers,

literal: but with-precious blood, as of-a-lamb unblemished and unspotted, of-Christ,
prose: but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot,

literal: having-been-foreknown indeed before, of-the-foundation of-the-world,
prose: ...foreknown indeed before [the foundation] of the world...

literal: but having-been-manifested at [the] last of-the times for-the-sake-of you, the [ones] through him faithful, into God, the [one] having-raised him out-of dead-[ones] and having-given glory to-him, so-that the faith of-you and hope might-be into God.
prose: but was manifested in the last of the times for your sake, you who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

literal: The souls of-you having-purified in the obedience of-the truth unto brotherly-love unfeigned, out-of heart one-another love ye earnestly,
prose: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth for genuine brotherly love, love one another earnestly from the heart,

literal: having-been-begotten-again not out-of seed perishable but of-imperishable, through word living of-God and abiding·
prose: having been born again not of perishable seed but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God,

literal: Because all flesh [is] as grass, and all its glory [is] as flower of-grass; the grass withered, and the flower fell.
prose: For all flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of grass. The grass withered, and the flower fell.

literal: But the word of-the-Lord remains into the age.
prose: But the word of the Lord remains forever.

literal: This but is the word, the [word] having-been-preached-as-good-news to you. Having put away therefore all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envies and all slanders,
prose: This is the word that was preached as good news to you. Therefore, having put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envies and all slander,

literal: As newborn babes, the reasonable guileless milk long-for [ye], so-that in it you-may-be-grown into salvation,
prose: Like newborn babes, long for the pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up into salvation,

literal: If you have tasted that good [is] the Lord.
prose: If indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.

literal: To whom coming, a stone living, by men indeed having-been-rejected, but with God chosen, precious,
prose: Coming to whom—a living stone, rejected indeed by men but with God chosen and precious—

literal: And yourselves, as living stones, you-are-being-built-up a-house spiritual, into a-priesthood holy, to-offer-up spiritual sacrifices well-acceptable to-God through Jesus Christ ·
prose: You also, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house, into a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

literal: Because it-is-contained in scripture: Behold, I-lay in Zion a-stone chosen, cornerstone, precious, and the-one believing on him not by-no-means shall-be-put-to-shame.
prose: For it is contained in scripture: 'Behold, I lay in Zion a chosen, precious cornerstone, and the one who believes in Him shall not be put to shame at all.'

literal: To-you therefore [belongs] the honor, to-the-ones believing; but-to-the-ones-disbelieving, a-stone which rejected the ones building, this-one became into head of-corner,
prose: Therefore, to you who believe [belongs] this honor; but to those who disbelieve, the stone which the builders rejected—this one became the head of the corner,

literal: and a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; who stumble at the word, disobeying; for which also they were appointed.
prose: and a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; they stumble because they disobey the word, for which they were also appointed.

literal: But you [are] a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for possession, so-that the excellences you-may-proclaim of-the-one out-of darkness you having-called into the marvelous his light;
prose: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for [his] own possession, so that you may proclaim the excellent deeds of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light;

literal: [You] who once [were] not a people, but now a people of God; [you] who [were] not having-been-shown-mercy, but now having-received-mercy.
prose: You who were once not a people are now the people of God; you who had not received mercy have now received mercy.

literal: Beloved, I-urge [you], as strangers and sojourners, to-abstain from-the fleshly desires, which wage-war against the soul,
prose: Beloved, I urge you, as strangers and sojourners, to abstain from fleshly desires, which wage war against the soul,

literal: Your conduct among the Gentiles having good, so that, in that which they speak against you as evildoers, from the good works observing, they may glorify God in the day of visitation.
prose: Keep your conduct honorable among the Gentiles, so that in the matter in which they slander you as evildoers, they may glorify God on the day of visitation, having observed your good deeds.

literal: Be-subjected to-every human institution on-account-of the Lord ·
prose: Submit yourselves to every human institution for the Lord's sake.

literal: Whether to-king as being-supreme, or to-governors as through him being-sent for punishment of-wrongdoers, but praise of-those-doing-good;
prose: Whether to the king as supreme, or to governors as sent by him for the punishment of wrongdoers, but the praise of those who do good;

literal: ( For thus is the will of the God, doing-good to-muzzle the of-the foolish men ignorance; )
prose: (For this is the will of God: that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.)

literal: As free-people, and not as having a covering of the evil the freedom, but as of-God slaves.
prose: As free people, and not using your freedom as a cover for evil, but as slaves of God.

literal: All [people] honor, the brotherhood love, God fear, the king honor.
prose: Honor everyone; love the brotherhood; fear God; honor the king.

literal: The servants, submitting-themselves in all fear to-the masters, not only to-the good and gentle, but also to-the crooked.
prose: Servants, submit yourselves with all fear to your masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the crooked.

literal: For this [is] a grace, if because-of conscience of-God endures anyone griefs, suffering unjustly ·
prose: For this is a grace, if for the sake of conscience toward God someone endures griefs while suffering unjustly.

literal: For what kind [is the] credit if, sinning and being buffeted, you will endure [it]?
prose: For what credit is there if you sin and are beaten for it, and endure it?

literal: For unto this you-were-called, because also Christ suffered on-behalf-of you, for-you leaving-behind an-example, in-order-that you-might-follow the footsteps of-him ·
prose: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered on your behalf, leaving you an example, so that you should follow in his footsteps.

literal: Who sin not did, nor was found deceit in the mouth of him;
prose: He committed no sin, nor was any deceit found in his mouth.

literal: but he was handing [himself] over to the one judging justly ·
prose: But he entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.

literal: He who our sins himself bore up in the body of-him upon the tree, so-that to-the sins having-become-dead, to-the righteousness we-might-live; by-whose the wound you-were-healed.
prose: He himself bore our sins in his body upon the tree, so that, having died to sins, we might live to righteousness. By whose wound you were healed.

literal: For you-were as sheep straying, but you-turned-back now upon the shepherd and overseer of-the souls of-you.
prose: For you were straying like sheep, but now you have turned back to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

literal: Likewise, wives, submitting-themselves to-the own husbands, so-that if some are-disobedient to-the word, through the of-the wives conduct, without word they-may-be-won,
prose: Likewise, wives, be submissive to your own husbands, so that even if some are disobedient to the word, they may be won over without a word through the conduct of their wives,

literal: ...having-observed the in fear pure conduct of-you(pl).
prose: ...when they have observed your pure conduct joined with reverence.

literal: Of whom let it be not the outward, of braiding of-hairs and of-putting-on of-gold-ornaments or of-putting-on of-garments, adornment,
prose: Let your adornment not be the outward kind—braided hair, gold jewelry, or fine clothing—

literal: but the hidden of-the heart person, in the imperishable of-the quiet and meek spirit, which is before God precious.
prose: but the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in the sight of God.

literal: For thus once also the holy women, the ones hoping in God, used to adorn themselves, submitting-themselves to-the own husbands,
prose: For thus in former times the holy women too, who hoped in God, used to adorn themselves, submitting themselves to their own husbands,

literal: As Sarah obeyed the Abraham, calling him lord; of whom you were made children, doing-good and not fearing no terror.
prose: As Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; of whom you have become children, doing good and fearing no terror.

literal: The husbands, likewise, dwelling-with [them] according to knowledge, as to a weaker vessel, to the female [vessel], assigning honor, as also fellow-heirs of grace of life, unto the not being-hindered of-the prayers of-you.
prose: Husbands, likewise, dwell with your wives with understanding, showing honor to the female one as to the weaker vessel, as also being fellow heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.

literal: But [as to] the end, all [be] like-minded, sympathetic, brother-loving, tenderhearted, humble-minded,
prose: Finally, be all of one mind, sympathetic, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, humble-minded,

literal: Not rendering evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing, because unto this you were called, in order that you might inherit a blessing.
prose: Not repaying evil for evil, or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing, because it was for this that you were called, so that you might inherit a blessing.

literal: For the-one wanting to-love life and to-see days good, let-him-stop the tongue from evil, and lips of-the not to-speak deceit,
prose: For let the one who wants to love life and see good days keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit,

literal: And let-him-turn-away from evil, and let-him-do good, let-him-seek peace and let-him-pursue it.
prose: Let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.

literal: Because eyes of-Lord [are] upon righteous-ones, and ears his [are] unto supplication of-them, but face of-Lord [is] upon [those] doing evil-things.
prose: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open to their supplication, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil things.

literal: And who [is] the-one who-will-harm you, if of-the good [you] zealots become?
prose: And who is there to harm you, if you become zealous for what is good?

literal: But if even you-should-suffer on-account-of righteousness, [you-are] blessed. The but fear of-them not fear, nor but be-troubled...
prose: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. Do not fear their fear, nor be troubled...

literal: but as Lord the Christ sanctify [him] in the hearts of you, ready always toward an-answer to-everyone who-asks you a-word concerning the in you hope, but with gentleness and reverence, conscience having good,
prose: But sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts, always ready to give an answer to anyone who asks you a reason for the hope that is in you, yet with gentleness and reverence, keeping a good conscience,

literal: so-that in that-which you-are-slandered may-be-put-to-shame the-ones reviling your good in Christ conduct.
prose: so that those who revile your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame in the very thing for which you are slandered.

literal: [It is] better, for, doing-good, if the-will of-the God should-wish [it], to-suffer, than doing-evil.
prose: For it is better, if God's will should so wish it, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

literal: Because also Christ once concerning sins died, righteous on-behalf-of unrighteous-ones, in-order-that you he-might-bring-to the God, having-been-put-to-death indeed in-flesh but having-been-made-alive in-spirit;
prose: Because Christ also died once for sins, righteous on behalf of the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, having been put to death in the flesh but made alive in the spirit;

literal: In which [he,] also, having gone, preached to the spirits in prison,
prose: In which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

literal: Having-been-disobedient formerly, when was-waiting the of-God patience, in days of-Noah, an-ark being-prepared, into which few, this is eight souls, were-brought-safely-through through water.
prose: Who formerly were disobedient, when the patience of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared, into which a few, that is, eight souls, were brought safely through water.

literal: which also you as-antitype now saves, baptism,—not of-flesh a-putting-away of-filth but of-conscience good an-appeal to God,—through resurrection of-Jesus Christ,
prose: which also now saves you, as an antitype, namely baptism—not a putting away of the filth of the flesh, but an appeal to God for a good conscience—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

literal: Who is at [the] right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to him.
prose: He is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to him.

literal: Christ therefore having-suffered in-flesh, also you the same mindset arm-yourselves, because the-one having-suffered in-flesh has-ceased from-sins,
prose: Christ, then, having suffered in the flesh, you also arm yourselves with the same mindset, because the one who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sins,

literal: Unto the [purpose] no-longer of-men for-desires but for-will of-God the remaining in flesh to-live time.
prose: So that he might live the rest of his time in the flesh no longer for the desires of men but for the will of God.

literal: For enough [is] the having-passed time to-have-accomplished the will of-the Gentiles, having-gone-about in debaucheries, lusts, drunkennesses, revelings, drinking-bouts, and lawless idolatries.
prose: For the time that has passed is enough to have carried out the will of the Gentiles, having lived in debauchery, lusts, drunkenness, revelings, drinking-bouts, and lawless idolatries.

literal: In which [respect] they are surprised, [because] you are not running together into the same flood of debauchery, slandering [you].
prose: In this they are surprised that you no longer run with them into that same flood of debauchery, and they slander you for it.

literal: who will render an account to the [one] readily judging [the] living and [the] dead;
prose: who will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

literal: For unto this [end] also to-the-dead was-it-gospel-preached, in-order-that they-might-be-judged on-the-one-hand according-to men in-flesh, but-on-the-other-hand they-might-live according-to God in-spirit.
prose: For this reason the gospel was preached also to the dead, so that, though judged in the flesh according to men, they might live in the spirit according to God.

literal: Of-all-things but the end has-drawn-near.
prose: But the end of all things has drawn near.

literal: Before all things the toward-one-another love earnest having, because love covers a-multitude of-sins;
prose: Above all, keep having earnest love for one another, because love covers a multitude of sins.

literal: Hospitable toward one another, without grumbling ·
prose: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

literal: Each-one, just-as he-received a-gift, toward one-another it serving, as good stewards of-varied grace of-God·
prose: Each one, as he received a gift, should use it to serve one another, as good stewards of the varied grace of God.

literal: If anyone speaks, as oracles-of-God [let him speak]; if anyone serves, as from strength which God supplies [let him serve]; so-that in all-things may-be-glorified God through Jesus Christ, to-whom is the glory and the power into the ages of-the ages; amen.
prose: If anyone speaks, let him speak as one uttering the oracles of God; if anyone serves, let him serve as one drawing from the strength that God supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

literal: Beloved, do not be-surprised at-the in you fiery-trial for testing to-you occurring, as of-something-strange to-you happening,
prose: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal occurring among you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you,

literal: But to-the-extent-that you-share in-the sufferings of-the Christ, rejoice, in-order-that also in the revelation of-the glory of-him you-may-rejoice, exulting.
prose: But to the extent that you share in the sufferings of Christ, rejoice, so that also in the revelation of his glory you may rejoice, exulting.

literal: If you-are-reviled in the-name of-Christ, blessed [are you], because the [Spirit] of-the glory and the [Spirit] of-the God, Spirit, rests upon you.
prose: If you are reviled for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you.

literal: For not anyone of-you let-him-suffer as a-murderer or a-thief or an-evildoer, or as a-meddler-in-others'-affairs;
prose: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evildoer, or as a meddler in others' affairs;

literal: But if as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify the God in this name.
prose: But if [anyone suffers] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in this name.

literal: Because [the] time [is] of-the beginning-of the judgment from the house of-the God.
prose: For it is [the] time for the judgment to begin from the household of God.

literal: And if the righteous-man scarcely is-saved, the [but] ungodly-man and sinful-man where will-appear?
prose: And if the righteous person is scarcely saved, where will the ungodly and sinful person appear?

literal: So-that also the [ones] suffering according-to the will of-the God to-a-faithful creator let-them-entrust the souls in well-doing.
prose: So then, let those who suffer according to the will of God entrust their souls to a faithful Creator, while doing good.

literal: Elders therefore among you I exhort, the fellow-elder and witness of the sufferings of the Christ, [he] who [is] also of the about-to-be-revealed glory a partaker,
prose: Elders among you, then, I exhort — I, a fellow elder and witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that is about to be revealed —

literal: Shepherd the [flock] among you flock of the God, not by-compulsion but willingly, nor and for-shameful-gain but eagerly,
prose: Shepherd the flock of God that is among you, not under compulsion but willingly, not for shameful gain but eagerly,

literal: nor as domineering-over the allotted-portions but becoming examples of-the flock ·
prose: nor as domineering over those allotted to your charge, but becoming examples to the flock.

literal: And [the] chief-shepherd having-been-made-manifest, you-will-receive the unfading of-the glory crown.
prose: And when the chief shepherd is revealed, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.

literal: Likewise, younger-men, be-subjected to-elders.
prose: Likewise, you younger men, submit yourselves to the elders.

literal: Be-humbled, therefore, under the mighty hand of the God, so-that you he-might-exalt in due-time,
prose: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, so that he may exalt you in due time,

literal: All the anxiety of-you having-cast upon him, because to-him it-is-a-care concerning you.
prose: Cast all your anxiety upon him, because he cares about you.

literal: The adversary of-you, [the] devil, as a-lion roaring, walks-about, seeking to-devour [someone];
prose: Your adversary the devil prowls about like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

literal: Whom resist, firm in-the faith, knowing the same-things of-the sufferings to-the in the world of-you brotherhood to-be-accomplished.
prose: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are being accomplished among your brotherhood throughout the world.

literal: But the God of all grace, the one having called you into his eternal glory in Christ, having suffered a little, he himself will restore [you], will establish [you], will strengthen [you].
prose: And the God of all grace, who called you into his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore, establish, and strengthen you.

literal: Amen.
prose: Amen.

literal: Through Silvanus to-you, the faithful brother, as I reckon, through few [words] I wrote, exhorting and testifying this to-be true grace of-the God; into which stand-firm [you].
prose: Through Silvanus, the faithful brother, as I reckon, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God; stand fast in it.

literal: Greets you the [woman] in Babylon co-elect, and Mark the son of-me.
prose: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and so does Mark my son.

literal: Greet one-another with a-kiss of-love. Peace to-you all the [ones] in Christ.
prose: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
